name: copilot
description: GitHub Copilot CLI, started with --allow-all (every tool, path and URL pre-approved).

settings.label: Mount ~/.copilot
settings.description: Hands the agent a per-run copy of your Copilot CLI config directory, login included, so no token is needed. Off: the agent starts on a fresh config with COPILOT_AUTH's token.

settings.label: Copilot config directory
settings.description: Host directory copied as the agent's ~/.copilot, for each run, while it is mounted.

settings.label: GitHub token
settings.description: The copilot-token (a fine-grained PAT with "Copilot Requests", or a Copilot/gh OAuth token) Copilot runs with; not needed while COPILOT_HOME_MOUNT mounts a logged-in ~/.copilot.
